title:
Effect of obesity on inhibitory control in preadolescents during stop-signal 
task. An event-related potentials study
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 57 obese and non-obese preadolescents performing a stop-signal task designed to assess inhibitory control. Data were collected at the Arkansas Children Nutrition Center using a 128-channel Geodesic Hydrocell Sensor Net system, aiming to investigate event-related potential differences associated with obesity in preteens.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Geodesic Net Amps 300 system with Netstation 4.5.2 software and a 128-channel Geodesic Hydrocell Sensor Net (Magstim EGI, Eugene OR, USA). Stimuli for the stop-signal task were designed and administered using E-Prime software (Version 2). No further processing was performed on the raw data.
